test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Addicted
solution:
The correct answer is-**"Inclined"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, **"Inclined"** is the most appropriate synonym of **"Addicted".**
 
• **Addicted:** difficult to control or resist something
 
 
• **Example:** She was addicted to smoking when she was young.
 
 
 
• **Inclined: **likely or wanting to do something
 
 
• **Example:** Jerry is** inclined** to be lazy all day.
 
 
 
• Thus, ***option 3) ***is the correct alternative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us understand the meaning of other options too.

 
• **Disinclined: **unwilling or reluctant

 
 
• **Example:** Since it goes against their Buddhist faith, they are **disinclined** to use violence.
 
 
 
• **Unaccustomed: **not familiar with or used to.
 
 
• **Example: **She was **unaccustomed **with the rules and regulations of the school as she was new.
 
 
 
• **Averse: **Strong dislike to something
 
 
• **Example: **When she was a four year old kid, she had an aversion to water.
